anomalies.description: Two men are engaged in a physical struggle: one man in a dark jacket is grabbing the other man's neck/upper chest while the second man, in a grey hoodie, appears to be resisting or being restrained. Their postures and contact indicate mutual physical combat.
Two men engage in a physical altercation in a living room; one man grabs the other's neck/collar and shoves him, followed by mutual grappling and pushing.

Two men engage in a physical altercation: one man (in dark jacket) initially grabs the other's neck/collar (f0–f1), then they separate slightly while gesturing aggressively (f2–f10); the man on the left retrieves a yellow object (possibly a bottle or container) from a shelf (f11–f13), and at f14–f15, he swings it toward the other man who begins to evade/retreat, indicating an escalation to potential weapon use in mutual combat.; Two men engage in mutual physical combat: one initiates a punch (f7), the other blocks/retaliates, and they grapple and struggle (f8–f12). The interaction involves reciprocal force and active resistance, consistent with fighting.

Two men are engaged in a physical struggle: they embrace tightly, lift each other off the ground, and move aggressively across the room, consistent with mutual combat.; After separating from the initial grapple, the two men continue to physically engage: one grabs the other’s collar/neck area, pushes, and gestures aggressively while maintaining close contact; the interaction remains confrontational and physical throughout.

After the initial fight, one man (in dark jacket) grabs the other (in blue jacket) by the neck/throat and lifts or shoves him backward (f13–f15), while the latter appears restrained and unable to effectively resist—indicating an abusive act where the victim is overpowered and helpless during the hold.
